entries.title_original: Resolución de 16 de septiembre de 2026, del Congreso de los Diputados, por la que se ordena la publicación del Acuerdo de convalidación del Real Decreto-ley 22/2026, de 1 de septiembre, por el que se aprueban medidas urgentes de carácter social y económico de apoyo a la ciudad de Ceuta.

headline.text: Spain's Congress validated Royal Decree-law (Real Decreto-ley) 22/2026 on 16 September 2026, confirming urgent social and economic measures for Ceuta.

what_changed.text: Congress approved the validation (convalidación) of Royal Decree-law 22/2026 of 1 September, which sets urgent social and economic support measures for Ceuta.
The 16 September 2026 resolution sets no measures itself; the Ceuta measures sit in Royal Decree-law (Real Decreto-ley) 22/2026 of 1 September.

who.text: The text names only the city of Ceuta and sets no sector, company size or employer role, so the ICP fit is not stated.

money.text: The text sets no amount, aid or penalty; any figures sit in Royal Decree-law 22/2026 itself.

facts.statement: Congress validated Royal Decree-law 22/2026 of 1 September, which sets urgent social and economic measures to support the city of Ceuta.

citation.quote: el Congreso de los Diputados, en su sesión del día de hoy, acordó convalidar el Real Decreto-ley 22/2026, de 1 de septiembre, por el que se aprueban medidas urgentes de carácter social y económico de apoyo a la ciudad de Ceuta

facts.statement: The Congress resolution of 16 September 2026 orders publication of the agreement validating Royal Decree-law 22/2026.

citation.quote: Resolución de 16 de septiembre de 2026, del Congreso de los Diputados, por la que se ordena la publicación del Acuerdo de convalidación del Real Decreto-ley 22/2026

forcing_mechanism.evidence: Congress validated Royal Decree-law (Real Decreto-ley) 22/2026 for Ceuta, and the text sets no deadline, penalty, grant or amount.

findable.evidence: No catalogue dataset targets Ceuta, and the facts name no grant that would place beneficiaries in the BDNS awards data.

early.evidence: BDNS lists companies only once a grant is awarded, which comes after any buying moment.

gap_evidence.evidence: The facts set no obligation on employers, so no public record can show which companies have not acted.

crowding.evidence: The facts do not describe the measures, so no incumbent solution can be tied to this decree.

confidence.reason: The text is a one-paragraph validation notice and does not reproduce the decree-law's measures, sectors, thresholds or amounts.
